function.description: Get real-time USD prices for one or more Solana token mints — pass raw mint addresses via mints, OR symbols/names/mints via queries (resolved automatically, no separate lookup tool needed first). Returns each requested id's price (under prices, or resolved for queries); any mint/query Jupiter could not price is listed in missing instead of being silently dropped. Provide exactly one of: mints, queries.
function.name: solana__token_prices_get

mints.description: Comma-separated mint addresses. Provide this OR queries, not both.

queries.description: Comma-separated token symbols, names, or mint addresses to resolve and price (e.g. "SOL,BONK"). Provide this OR mints, not both.
